description: This Java class 'Hooks' provides Cucumber framework hooks for managing WebDriver lifecycle within BDD test scenarios. It handles WebDriver initialization, configuration logging, scenario tagging, failure screenshots, and cleanup, with consideration for parallel execution and scenario-specific behavior.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Cucumber hooks class managing WebDriver lifecycle and scenario logging.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Pre-scenario setup: logs config, scenario info, and initializes WebDriver unless scenario is database-only.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Post-scenario cleanup: captures screenshot on failure, quits WebDriver, and logs scenario completion.

methods.name: logConfigOnce
methods.description: Logs the environment configuration summary exactly once at the beginning of test execution.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Attempts to capture a screenshot of the WebDriver and attach it to the scenario report, handling errors gracefully.
